message_1_subject: Acme pilot - discovery recap + next steps
message_1_body:
Hi Elena / Ben,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great discussion. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Priority & success metrics: Acme wants a 6-week pilot focusing on product search relevance and support ticket summarization; target latency < 300ms at 95th pct for the search flow.
- Data & security: You confirmed data will stay in us-west and that the pilot will use masked PII; will confirm retention window once procurement weighs in.
- Billing & pricing: We covered pilot pricing and potential transition to dedicated capacity if throughput grows.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Redwood to send SOW + initial contract redlines to your counsel (Marissa) — by EOD 2026-03-02.
2) Acme to confirm procurement/counsel contact and target sign date — Elena / Ben — ideally by 2026-03-05.
3) Schedule onboarding week tentatively in the week of 3/22 (holds on both calendars) — once contract is in place.

I’m attaching the draft SOW + summarized redlines for visibility and will send the full contract redlines to your counsel tomorrow. If the timeline changes on your side (priority or resourcing), please let me know so we can adjust.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

message_4_subject: Re: Fwd: Acme redlines - initial legal comments
message_4_body:
Marissa / Jonas —

Quick take after an initial pass:

1) Data retention/deletion: we can agree to standard deletion timelines for pilot data (30-90 days) and provide deletion attestations; we should avoid operational commitments that require on-demand proof unless we include add-on professional services.
2) Liability & indemnity: the requested unlimited indemnity and high liability cap is outside our standard; propose reciprocal indemnities with a commercial cap tied to contract value (e.g., 2x pilot fees for pilot stage) and carve-outs for gross negligence/fraud.
3) IP & usage rights: clarify that model improvements from the pilot will be governed by existing TOS (Redwood retains model-level IP; ACME retains customer data).

I’ve attached annotated comments (RW_Legal_Comments_Acme_v1.pdf). I recommend we propose a redline back to Acme with our suggested language and a short covering note that explains the pilot nature and limited scope. If sales wants to offer a one-time concession on the cap for enterprise procurement, tell me the threshold and I’ll bake it into the response.

If you want, I can draft the email and redline and send it directly to Acme counsel — saves you an extra step.

Rishi
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: RW_Legal_Comments_Acme_v1.pdf
